description: D440: interleaved A/B of compose-rs's hint session variants (docs/14, 'The main thread in the session'). a: main 18272a3 (the RenderThread alone, its CPU time against 6.5 ms); b: the main thread in the session too, same reports; c8 / c10: both threads, reporting both threads' CPU time since the last frame against 8.33 / 10 ms. Pixel 8 Pro, speed, 12 runs each, variants rotating each round; CPU, work and energy over 13 s (scroll) or 9 s (animation) from the measured start.
